subject: Arbory: combined trial extension + credit request — exec approval needed
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@arbory.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference.com>, sales@redwood.inference.com
Cc: Maya Singh <maya@arbory.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Aug 2027 09:14:00 -0400
Subject: Request: trial extension + credits to complete PoC

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the proof-of-concept is shaping up well. Engineering has run into unexpected throughput headwinds and we need more runway to validate cost and latency at scale. Two asks from our side: a 60-day trial extension (we only have ~10 days left) and an incremental $25,000 in platform credits to cover expanded test workloads and storage during the extended PoC.

We believe Arbory can move to a paid commitment if the extended run shows the model meets our latency SLOs on 3-node inference clusters. We are targeting a final decision by end of Q4.

Can Redwood approve this concession? If it helps, we are willing to do a 12-month minimum commitment (terms to be finalized) if we get the credits and extension.

Appreciate any flexibility — Oliver
Oliver Grant
Head of ML Platforms, Arbory Robotics
oliver@arbory.com

---
Note: we will need an updated order form and DocuSign to sign any commitment if approved.

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Aug 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Arbory - request for trial extension + credits (exec approval requested)

Folks — forwarding Arbory's ask. Quick summary below and request for an exec exception:

Summary:
- External: Arbory Robotics (prospect) — Head of ML Platforms Oliver Grant.
- Ask: 60-day PoC extension + $25k platform credits.
- Trade: They are willing to move to a 12-month minimum commitment if we grant the credits and extension.
- Timeline: Decision needed within next week to keep PoC momentum.

Why this matters:
- High technical fit (low latency requirements, similar workload to existing reference customers).
- Opportunity to land a 1–2 year commercial account in an emerging robotics vertical.
- Risk: granting this without a commit increases short-term cost but may accelerate expansion.

Requested approval (what I recommend):
- Approve 60-day extension.
- Approve $20k in non-recoupable platform credits now + $5k escrowed, released on signed 12-month commitment within 60 days.
- 10% list discount on the first-year ARR if they sign the 12-month commitment.

Attachments: draft order form + an exec approval memo for finance sign-off.

Please reply with APPROVE / DENY / NEEDS CHANGES. If APPROVE, I'll send the updated order form + DocuSign to Oliver and Maya.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.inference.com
(415) 555-0126

Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Arbory - request for trial extension + credits (exec approval requested)

Vanessa — good summary. Finance has reviewed the draft and we can approve with the following firm conditions: 

1) Non-recoupable credits: $15,000 up-front. Additional $10,000 will be held as contingent credits and will be released upon execution of the signed 12-month commitment within 60 days.
2) Discount: approve up to 12% on first-year ARR (sliding to 10% if legal redlines extend beyond 10 business days).
3) Contract amendment: we need a signed amendment or PO that explicitly references the credits and the commit timeline; legal to include a clawback clause if commitment is not signed within 60 days.
4) Escalation: if deal legal needs more time, Priyom to coordinate a temporary bridge credit release for outstanding infra costs on a case-by-case basis.

Marissa will sign the exec approval memo once Vanessa confirms the exact credit schedule and that legal will accept the clawback language.

Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Finance — Redwood Inference

Hi Oliver / Maya,

Thanks for your patience — finance has signed off on an exception to help you finish the PoC. Below are the confirmed terms and next steps.

- Trial extension: 60 days from today (to 2027-10-28).
- Credits: $15,000 non-recoupable issued now; $10,000 contingent credits released upon receipt of signed 12-month commitment within 60 days.
- Discount: up to 12% on first-year ARR, final rate to be captured in the signed order form.

Conditions:
- Legal will include a clawback clause for the contingent credits if the 12-month commit is not signed within 60 days.
